body:
T=0 mins
I filled the empty glass coffee pot with a few cups of tap water and poured this water into the reservoir within the coffee machine. Next, I scooped some premium dry Folgers coffee and poured the coffee powder into an unbleached coffee filter. I then turned the machine onto the brew setting and watched the warm dark liquid dribble into the coffee pot.
T+3 mins
The machine beeped a few times (indicating the brew was complete and ready to be enjoyed) and I yelled 'FRESH POTS!' as you do when coffee is ready. I proceeded to grab my favorite mug and poured 10 fl oz of fresh coffee into said mug and then drank the fresh brew.
T+20 mins
Started to feel alert and awake. Accordingly, there was an urgency for a bowel movement as it was morning.
Overall, great experience. 10/10
